title: The Unquiet Alibi
author: Ada Eriksen
blurb: Emrys Crane, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
